method: Deterministic calculations only; no language model generated these facts.

facts.provider: U.S. Census Bureau Building Permits Survey
facts.comparison: Same months of 2025
facts.coverage: 89 matched permit jurisdictions
facts.evidence: 22,318 units were authorized, compared with 15,550 in the same months one year earlier.
facts.caveat: Current-year observations are preliminary and may be revised or imputed; permits are authorizations, not starts or completions.

facts.provider: U.S. Census Bureau Building Permits Survey

facts.comparison: Inflation-adjusted change from one year earlier
facts.coverage: Common-month Zillow ZHVI and LA-area CPI-U
facts.evidence: Nominal ZHVI changed +1.3% while LA-area CPI-U changed +3.7%.
facts.caveat: Real change is a purchasing-power comparison, not an affordability measure.

facts.comparison: Median local change from one year earlier
facts.coverage: 57 of 85 local markets had calculable year-over-year changes
facts.evidence: The median local change was +20.7%; among 57 markets with calculable changes, 38 increased, 18 decreased, and 1 was unchanged.
facts.caveat: Unweighted median across covered local markets; it is not a county aggregate.

facts.comparison: Same month one year earlier
facts.coverage: Official LA-area CPI-U series
facts.evidence: CPI-U was 358.725, a change of +3.7% from one year earlier.
facts.caveat: Not seasonally adjusted; the area index covers Los Angeles and Orange Counties. The latest index observation (2026-10-31) has no calculable year-over-year change; this comparison uses 2026-09-30.
